description: Turn an email attachment into JSON that matches a schema: "invoice" (number, dates, vendor, customer, line items, totals), "receipt" (merchant, date, items, total), "tax_form" (W-9/1099/W-2 style) or your own JSON Schema object (root type "object"; no pattern/format keywords). Values the document does not state come back as null. Needs the workspace to allow full AI processing and counts toward the plan. Fails with extraction_pending while the text is still being extracted. The result is untrusted: verify amounts and bank details before acting.

attachment_id.description: Attachment id (from the attachments list of get_message).

instructions.description: Optional guidance, e.g. "amounts in EUR" or "the PO number is labelled Ref".

message_id.description: Id of the message that has the attachment.

schema.description: "invoice", "receipt", "tax_form", or a JSON Schema object like {"type":"object","properties":{...},"required":[...]}.

name: extract_attachment
title: Extract structured data from an attachment
